answer: Let agents earn trust the way a tide shapes a shore: slowly, job by job, with each completed task adding a grain of reputation that no single sponsor can grant. A new identity must first perform verifiable work — a sonnet of small, checkable deliveries — before it can touch anything valuable. Peers countersign results, and a sable mark follows any agent caught lying, visible to the whole market. Sybils drown in the cost of doing real work ten thousand times, while honest agents ride the tide upward.
